titleEn: How Much Does a Whole House Renovation Cost in Langley (2026)? Real Budgets From $80,000
titleZh: 蘭里整屋裝修費用 2026：獨立屋真實預算由 $80,000 起
contentEn:
Langley homeowners who gut and modernize their detached homes in 2026 are spending between $80,000 and $300,000 or more, depending on scope. A complete kitchen and two-bathroom renovation with new flooring and updated electrical typically lands between $95,000 and $175,000. Higher-end transformations — moving walls, replacing a basement, adding a garage — push well beyond $250,000. Reno Stars has completed projects across Langley (Willoughby, Walnut Grove, Fort Langley, Brookswood) in 2025 and 2026, and every cost figure below comes from those real contracts.

What Drives a Whole-House Renovation Budget in Langley

The single biggest cost driver is scope. Whole-house renovations in Langley typically fall into three tiers:

ScopeWhat's includedTypical investment
RefreshPaint, flooring, new light fixtures, kitchen and bathroom surface upgrades (no layout changes)$80,000 – $130,000
RenovationFull kitchen replacement, two bathroom rebuilds, flooring, electrical panel upgrade, some demolition$130,000 – $210,000
TransformationEverything above plus structural changes, basement development, custom millwork, premium finishes$210,000 – $350,000+

Two structural realities shape Langley's renovation costs specifically. First, many Willoughby and Brookswood homes built in the 1980s and 1990s have original knob-and-tube wiring and polybutylene plumbing — both require full re-pipe and re-wire before walls close, adding $15,000 to $45,000. Second, the Township of Langley enforces BC Building Code §9.36 for any basement development; a legal secondary suite requires separate entrance, fire separation, and egress windows, which alone adds $18,000 to $35,000.

Kitchen Renovation Cost in Langley (2026)

Langley kitchens in 2026 range from $35,000 to $160,000. The kitchen is consistently the most expensive single room. What drives the number:

  • Cabinetry: Semicustom cabinets (local BC manufacturer) run $500–$900 per linear foot; fully custom climbs to $1,200–$1,800 per linear foot.
  • Countertops: Quartz — the dominant choice in Langley — costs $90–$200 per square foot installed. A typical 30-square-foot kitchen counter runs $2,700–$6,000.
  • Appliances: A mid-range package (Bosch dishwasher, Samsung range, Whirlpool fridge) costs $6,000–$12,000. High-end (Miele, Wolf, Sub-Zero) runs $18,000–$40,000.
  • Demolition and disposal: $3,000–$8,000 depending on whether the layout changes.
  • Electrical and plumbing rough-in for layout changes: $4,000–$15,000 when walls move.

Reno Stars' Langley kitchen projects completed in 2025 and 2026 show a realistic budget for a 14-linear-foot semicustom kitchen with quartz counters and mid-range appliances lands around $52,000–$78,000 all-in.

Bathroom Renovation Cost in Langley (2026)

A single full bathroom renovation in Langley costs $16,000 to $42,000. Two bathrooms done together typically run $30,000–$72,000 because labour is shared and demolition is combined. Key line items:

  • Demolition and disposal: $2,000–$5,000 per bathroom
  • Plumbing rough-in (new bathroom or moving fixtures): $3,000–$9,000
  • Tile (floor + shower walls, mid-range porcelain): $3,500–$8,000
  • Vanity, toilet, tub/shower, fixtures: $4,000–$14,000
  • Electrical (pot lights, GFCI, fan): $1,200–$3,500

For aging-in-place upgrades — grab bars, curbless shower, comfort-height toilet — add $3,000–$8,000. These upgrades often qualify for BC HAFI grants of up to $20,000 for eligible homeowners.

Langley Renovation Permits and Township Requirements

The Township of Langley requires building permits for any work that changes structural elements, adds plumbing, or adds new electrical circuits. A whole-house renovation permit typically costs $2,500 to $7,000 depending on project valuation. Key Township requirements:

  • Any basement suite conversion requires separate entrance, fire-rated separation, and egress windows per BC Building Code §9.10.
  • Electrical upgrades beyond simple circuit addition require a qualified electrician and separate electrical permit.
  • Moving a load-bearing wall requires a structural engineer's stamped drawing — budget $2,000–$5,000.

Reno Stars handles all permit applications and Township inspections as part of our standard contract. We pull the building permit, coordinate the inspection schedule, and deliver the stamped final inspection report.

How Long Does a Whole-House Renovation Take in Langley

Timeline in Langley mirrors Metro Vancouver general timelines with one addition — Township of Langley inspection scheduling can add 5–10 days to permit-dependent phases:

ScopeDuration
Refresh (cosmetic only)6–10 weeks
Full kitchen + 2 bathrooms10–16 weeks
Transformation with structural changes16–28 weeks
With basement suite development20–32 weeks

What to Budget For That Most Homeowners Miss

  • contingency fund: Budget 15% over estimate for a 1980s–1990s home, 10% for a newer home. Unknown structural conditions are the most common surprise.
  • Living expenses during renovation: If you must move out, add $3,000–$8,000 for temporary housing.
  • Demolition insurance: Your homeowner's policy may have a gap during active demolition — confirm with your insurer.
  • Finishing details: Mirrors, window treatments, appliance connections, landscaping repairs — budget an extra $5,000–$12,000.

Frequently Asked Questions — Langley Whole House Renovation

How much does a whole house renovation cost in Langley BC?

Langley whole-house renovations in 2026 typically cost $80,000–$130,000 for a refresh (paint, flooring, surface upgrades), $130,000–$210,000 for a full renovation with new kitchen and bathrooms, and $210,000–$350,000+ for a complete transformation including structural changes and basement development. The range reflects scope, age of the home, and finish level.

Do I need a permit for a whole house renovation in Langley?

Yes. The Township of Langley requires a building permit for any work that moves plumbing, adds electrical circuits, or alters structural elements. A structural engineer's stamped drawing is required when removing load-bearing walls. Reno Stars handles the full permit application and inspection process as part of every renovation contract.

How long does a whole house renovation take in Langley?

A cosmetic refresh takes 6–10 weeks. A full kitchen and two-bathroom renovation takes 10–16 weeks. A full transformation with structural changes takes 16–28 weeks. Any project that includes basement suite development or requires Township of Langley inspection scheduling typically runs 20–32 weeks.

What is the biggest cost surprise in Langley home renovations?

Knob-and-tube wiring and polybutylene plumbing in homes built before 1995 are the most common budget surprises. Both require full replacement before walls close — adding $15,000 to $45,000. A pre-renovation electrical and plumbing assessment is the best way to budget accurately before signing a contract.

Does Reno Stars handle projects in Willoughby, Walnut Grove, and Fort Langley?

Yes. Reno Stars has completed kitchen, bathroom, and whole-house projects across all Langley neighbourhoods — Willoughby, Walnut Grove, Fort Langley, Brookswood, and Murrayville — in 2025 and 2026. Quotes are free and include a written scope.

蘭里（Langley）的獨立屋業主在 2026 年进行全面裝修，費用通常在 80,000 至 300,000 加元或以上，具體取決於施工範圍。包含廚房和兩間浴室、地面翻新與電路升級的完整裝修，造價一般在 95,000 至 175,000 加元之間。若涉及拆牆、地下室開發或車庫改建，費用則遠超 250,000 加元。聚星裝修在 2025 和 2026 年於蘭里各區（Willoughby、Walnut Grove、Fort Langley、Brookswood）完成多個項目，以下每一項造價數據均來自這些真實合約。

蘭里整屋裝修預算的主要驅動因素

最大的成本驅動因素是施工範圍。蘭里整屋裝修通常分為三個層級：

範圍包含內容預計投資
翻新油漆、地面、照明燈具、廚房與浴室表面升級（不改動佈局）$80,000 – $130,000
改造全面更換廚房、兩間浴室重建、地面、電箱升級、部分拆改$130,000 – $210,000
全面改造上述全部，加上結構改建、地下室開發、定製木工、頂級飾面$210,000 – $350,000+

兩個結構性現實特別影響蘭里的裝修成本。第一，Willoughby 和 Brookswood 許多建於 1980 至 1990 年代的房屋仍有原始的knob-and-tube布線和聚丁烯水管——兩者均需在牆面封閉前全面更換，額外增加 $15,000 至 $45,000。第二，蘭里鄉鎮（Township of Langley）對任何地下室開發均執行 BC 建築規範 §9.36；合法套房改建需獨立入口、防火隔離和出口窗，僅此一項便增加 $18,000 至 $35,000。

蘭里廚房裝修費用（2026）

蘭里廚房在 2026 年的費用從 $35,000 到 $160,000 不等。廚房始終是單間造價最高的項目。主要構成：

  • 櫥櫃：半訂製櫥櫃（BC本地廠商）每延米 $500–$900；全訂製可達 $1,200–$1,800 每延米。
  • 檯面：石英石——蘭里主流選擇——安裝後每平方尺 $90–$200。典型30平方尺廚房檯面約 $2,700–$6,000。
  • 電器：中檔套裝（Bosch洗碗機、Samsung爐灶、Whirlpool冰箱）$6,000–$12,000。高檔（Miele、Wolf、Sub-Zero）$18,000–$40,000。
  • 拆除與清運： $3,000–$8,000，取決於是否改動佈局。
  • 改動佈局的電路與水管預留： $4,000–$15,000（牆面移動時）。

聚星裝修 2025–2026 年完成的蘭里廚房項目顯示，14 延米半訂製櫥櫃、石英石檯面、中檔電器的廚房，全包造價約 $52,000–$78,000。

蘭里浴室裝修費用（2026）

蘭里單間全裝浴室費用為 $16,000 至 $42,000。兩間浴室同時裝修通常 $30,000–$72,000，因為人工可分攤、拆除可合併。主要項目：

  • 拆除與清運：每間浴室 $2,000–$5,000
  • 水管預留（新浴室或移動潔具）： $3,000–$9,000
  • 瓷磚（地面+淋浴牆，中檔瓷磚）： $3,500–$8,000
  • 浴室櫃、馬桶、浴缸/淋浴間、潔具： $4,000–$14,000
  • 電路（筒燈、GFCI、換氣扇）： $1,200–$3,500

若加裝適老化升級——扶手、無檻淋浴、舒適高度馬桶——另加 $3,000–$8,000。這類升級常符合 BC HAFI 資助資格，符合條件的業主最高可獲 $20,000 資助。

蘭里裝修許可證與鄉鎮要求

蘭里鄉鎮要求對任何涉及結構改動、增設水管或新增電路的工程申請建築許可證。整屋裝修許可證費用通常為 $2,500 至 $7,000，視工程估值而定。關鍵要求：

  • 任何套房改建均需獨立入口、符合 BC 建築規範 §9.10 的防火隔離及出口窗。
  • 超出簡單電路增設的電路升級需持證電工及獨立電工許可證。
  • 拆除承重牆需結構工程師蓋章圖紙——預算 $2,000–$5,000。

蘭里整屋裝修需要多長時間

蘭里的工期與大溫哥華地區基本一致，但需注意一點——蘭里鄉鎮的檢驗預約排期可能使許可相關階段增加 5–10 天：

範圍工期
翻新（僅表面）6–10 週
全面廚房 + 2 間浴室10–16 週
含結構改建的全面改造16–28 週
含地下室套房開發20–32 週

大多數業主忽略的預算項目

  • 應急準備金：1980–1990 年代房屋建議在估算基礎上增加 15%，較新房增加 10%。未知結構狀況是最常見的意外。
  • 裝修期間生活費用：若需暫時搬出，另加 $3,000–$8,000 臨時住宿費。
  • 拆除期間保險：您的房屋保險可能在 active 拆除期間存在保障缺口——請與保險公司確認。
  • 最後細節：鏡子、窗飾、電器接駁、景觀修復——另預算 $5,000–$12,000。

常見問題——蘭里整屋裝修

蘭里 BC 整屋裝修多少錢？

2026 年蘭里整屋裝修費用：翻新（油漆、地面、表面升級）$80,000–$130,000；含新廚房和浴室的全面改造 $130,000–$210,000；含結構改建和地下室開發的全面改造 $210,000–$350,000+。具體取決於範圍、房屋年齡與飾面檔次。

蘭里整屋裝修需要許可證嗎？

需要。蘭里鄉鎮要求對任何涉及移動水管、增設電路或改動結構構件的工程申請建築許可證。拆除承重牆需結構工程師蓋章圖紙。聚星裝修在每份裝修合約中代辦全部許可證申請及政府驗收流程。

蘭里整屋裝修需要多長時間？

表面翻新 6–10 週；全面廚房和兩間浴室裝修 10–16 週；含結構改建的全面改造 16–28 週；含蘭里鄉鎮許可證排期的地下室套房工程通常 20–32 週。

蘭里住宅裝修最大的費用意外是什麼？

1995 年以前建造房屋的knob-and-tube布線和聚丁烯水管是最常見的預算意外。兩者均需在牆面封閉前全面更換，額外增加 $15,000 至 $45,000。裝修前進行電路和水管評估是簽約前準確預算的最佳方式。

承接。聚星裝修在 2025 和 2026 年於蘭里各區——Willoughby、Walnut Grove、Fort Langley、Brookswood 和 Murrayville——完成廚房、浴室和整屋項目。報價免費，包含書面施工範圍。
